task.title: Leakage-aware classification experiment
task.prompt: Create a rigorous binary classification notebook with sklearn.datasets.load_breast_cancer. Use stratified train/test split with random_state=42 and a Pipeline(StandardScaler, LogisticRegression). Avoid preprocessing leakage. Compare against DummyClassifier baseline; report accuracy, precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC and confusion matrix. Include class balance, explain metric choice, inspect at least three misclassified cases if any, and create ROC/confusion-matrix plots. Assertions must verify dimensions, finite metrics, and model beats baseline accuracy. Print BENCHMARK_RESULT=<JSON> with task_id, accuracy, f1, roc_auc, baseline_accuracy, test_samples.
